decisions.reason: The medical examination light extends the firm's established lighting capabilities into an institutional niche and, after several years of commitment and a dedicated launch presentation, management is likely to continue backing it unless performance clearly collapses.

The designer task light is close to the existing offer and was publicly relaunched as a popular model, so prior responsibility and reputational commitment make withdrawal less likely than continued support.

The pendant office luminaire sits squarely in the firm's core building and workplace business and matches its stated LED efficiency direction, which encourages management to persist with the 2019 launch.
The premium pendant luminaire is a close-fit product line with several models, implying higher development and commercialization investment that management is especially prone to defend and retain.
